E1.evidence: Public issue with command, parameter file, device format list and log ending "[ros2run]: Segmentation fault". Maintainer flynneva: "I can reproduce this error as well and have tracked it down to the `av_image_alloc` call" (https://github.com/ros-drivers/usb_cam/issues/225#issuecomment-1474530249). Fixed by merged PR #237 (3a1aea43).

units_identified: FFmpeg libavcodec/libavutil (MJPEG decoding), with the V4L2 camera as the image source
E2.evidence: The crash is in usb_cam's own decoder setup, independent of the camera and of which FFmpeg build is used. Maintainer: "root cause -> the way that `usb_cam` (this repo) was handling setting of the pixel format needed to be rethought." (https://github.com/ros-drivers/usb_cam/issues/225#issuecomment-1484373540). At the pre-fix revision bee4e6d2, UsbCam::init_decoder calls "av_image_alloc(\n    reinterpret_cast<uint8_t **>(avframe_rgb_), 0, image_width, image_height, AV_PIX_FMT_RGB24, 1);" (a null linesizes argument), the call the maintainer identified. Every MJPEG configuration reaches this path (reporter: "using yuyv is OK, but using mjpeg will report an error"; another user: "For me nothing works, except `yuyv`, even though the camera supports `mjpeg` and `h264`"), so the failure would occur with any correct camera and any correct FFmpeg. PR #237 rewrites usb_cam's pixel-format handling (new include/usb_cam/formats/*.hpp; the MJPEG path no longer calls av_image_alloc); no interface of another unit changes.

E3.evidence: Would be PAIR (camera MJPEG frames decoded by usb_cam through FFmpeg). Not decisive because the case stops at E2.

E4.evidence: Observed crash: "[ros2run]: Segmentation fault" after "Starting 'test_camera' (/dev/video0) at 1280x720 via mmap (mjpeg, yuv422p) at 30 FPS".

notes: Borderline between internal and a library-API misuse crossing the usb_cam/FFmpeg boundary; recorded as internal because the argument usb_cam passes does not depend on any version- or peer-specific assumption and the maintainer places the root cause in usb_cam's own pixel-format handling. The exact faulting instruction is shown only in a screenshot; the attribution to the null linesizes argument is from the code, not stated in the source. PR #237 also changed the pixel_format parameter values (maintainer: "the paramater file has changed slightly ... `mjpeg2rgb` and `yuyv2rgb` are the two you want to test"), a node-internal parameter change that users must follow; the reporter confirmed the ros2 branch after #237 works (https://github.com/ros-drivers/usb_cam/issues/225#issuecomment-1493977030, screenshots only). The reporter's usb_cam version and ROS distro are not stated.
